_comment: Maps a UI language (as named in the app) to a URL or local file path for that language's global.ini. On switching to a non-English language, Smart Citizen fetches this source and uses it as the base.ini for that language instead of the English Data.p4k extraction — a URL is downloaded, a local path is copied. English is intentionally absent (it uses the local P4K extraction). Use a raw file URL (raw.githubusercontent.com/...), not a github.com /blob/ or /tree/ page URL, which serve HTML. A blank value means no source is mapped here; set one via the Config tab's 'Map Language File' button (which stores a per-user URL or local path override that wins over this file) instead. korean is deliberately blank: the community source's license forbids redistribution, so there's no URL to bundle — see languages/TRANSLATIONS.md.
